title: Stable Signer V3: 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting Is All You Need for Sign Language Production
abstract: arXiv:2610.24926v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present Stable Signer V3, an interactive high-resolution sign language avatar system built on 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting. It addresses three limitations of existing avatars: restricted facial expression, inaccurate identity-specific body deformation, and loss of fine appearance details. Shared Face Primitive Splatting adds transferable superquadric primitives for richer expression control; Test-Time Body Primitive Splatting learns an identity-specific virtual muscle layer for more faithful motion; and Test-Time Tunneling Super-Resolution uses TunnelingNet to recover identity-specific high-resolution details. Both test-time modules are optimized once per signer identity; inference then runs entirely from the stored identity parameters. Together, they reduce facial geometry error by 71.4%, body-boundary error by 35.1% across ten identities, and high-resolution RGB reconstruction error by 24.2% on held-out evaluations, w

translated_title: Stable Signer V3：4D可变形图元泼溅是手语生成所需的全部
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Stable Signer V3，一个基于4D可变形图元泼溅（4D Deformable Primitive Splatting）构建的交互式高分辨率手语虚拟形象系统。它解决了现有虚拟形象的三个局限性：面部表情受限、身份特定的身体变形不准确、以及精细外观细节的丢失。共享面部图元泼溅（Shared Face Primitive Splatting）增加了可迁移的超二次曲面图元，以实现更丰富的表情控制；测试时身体图元泼溅（Test-Time Body Primitive Splatting）学习一种身份特定的虚拟肌肉层，以实现更逼真的运动；测试时隧穿超分辨率（Test-Time Tunneling Super-Resolution）使用TunnelingNet恢复身份特定的高分辨率细节。这两个测试时模块均针对每个手语者身份仅优化一次；之后推理完全基于存储的身份参数运行。它们共同将面部几何误差降低了71.4%，在十个身份上将身体边界误差降低了35.1%，并在留出评估中将高分辨率RGB重建误差降低了24.2%。
tldr: Stable Signer V3基于4D可变形图元泼溅技术，通过共享面部图元泼溅、测试时身体图元泼溅和隧穿超分辨率三项创新，显著提升了手语虚拟形象的表情丰富度、身体变形准确性和高分辨率细节保真度。
en_tdlr: Stable Signer V3 is an interactive high-resolution sign language avatar system built on 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting, combining shared face primitives, test-time body primitives, and TunnelingNet super-resolution to reduce facial geometry error by 71.4%, body-boundary error by 35.1%, and RGB reconstruction error by 24.2%.
